title: Show the available update changelog from update notifications
summary: Read from-update from the changelog route, reload notes on query changes, and pass the available-update flag from notifications.

title: Keep shared command-line databases when deleting a backup
summary: Check the existing isdbusedelsewhere API, explain shared or unavailable ownership checks, and keep the local database when deletion is not verified safe.

title: Cover keyboard reopening of loaded and empty folders
summary: Add regression coverage for collapsing and reopening loaded folders, child focus, empty folder expansion and avoiding repeated loads. The suspected bug did not reproduce on current main; no production change is included.

title: Bind command editor inputs through Signal Forms
summary: Use public Signal Forms compatibility adapters for command and metadata inputs while keeping command generation, source-argument switching, filters and saved URL state unchanged. This is a staged migration, not a claim that all of #497 is complete.

title: Confirm new unencrypted remote backups before saving
summary: Ask explicitly before saving a new unencrypted remote backup. Cancellation sends no backup request; duplicate clicks and stale confirmations are guarded. Existing jobs, encrypted jobs, local destinations and Sync retain their current save flow.

title: Offer existing local databases for new backup destinations
summary: After connection validation, look for the destination's command-line database. Let the user reuse it, create a new database or cancel, and only send the chosen DBPath for the matching new destination.

title: Use a native console connection link in destination forms
summary: Render Connect now as a RouterLink anchor so browser modified-click, link copying and native keyboard navigation retain their normal meaning without editing the destination.

title: Exercise wizard-created encrypted backups through a real restore
summary: Extend the existing isolated live-server round trip with a job created through the General, Source, Destination, Schedule and Options screens, then run and restore it and compare original UTF-8 and binary contents. Reuse the existing fixture and single Playwright config.
